data.gender_notes: Nasirul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nasirul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nasati', which means 'to vanquish' or 'to conquer'. This name is often given to a boy who is expected to overcome challenges and emerge victorious. It is a powerful and inspiring name that symbolizes strength and courage. The name Nasirul carries the meaning “Victory over the enemy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nasirul usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over the enemy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
